components.css: .ds-day-card{width:275px;height:190px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--color-work);border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-surface);color:var(--color-ink);font:600 13px Manrope,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.ds-day-card small{color:var(--color-work);font-size:10px}.ds-day-card small span{float:right}.ds-day-card>div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.ds-day-card time{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-right:14px;border-right:1px solid var(--color-edge);font-size:32px;color:var(--color-work)}.ds-day-card time em{font:500 13px Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-day-card p{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.ds-day-card strong{font-size:42px;line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-day-card p span,.ds-day-card footer{color:var(--color-work)}.ds-day-card footer{text-align:center;font-size:11px}

narrative.overview: A compact dark schedule that makes the selected personal shift the first read. Calendar, events, and statistics remain available but visually quieter; desktop opens the same ledger into two columns.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected date and shift readable without scrolling the phone's central schedule.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Shift text communicates status; color reinforces it.

rules.name: The Whole Month Rule
rules.body: Fit every calendar week and summary in the phone schedule.

rules.name: The Stable Card Rule
rules.body: Date and shift changes do not reflow adjacent controls.

dos: Do prioritize the selected shift over statistics and administrative actions.
Do keep the supplied panda stickers tied to shift status.
Do keep the phone's central schedule static and fit six-week months.
donts: Don't add explanatory labels, decorative gradients, or floating section cards.
Don't use color alone to communicate work, leave, late shifts, or selection.
